title: Constitutional provision
description: Chapter 5, Definition 1. A constitution is a pair (Rules, absolute): each provision is marked ordinary or non-overridable.

absolute.description: A statutory or safety floor no precedent of any authority can soften. A6 short-circuits it: immediate denial, no retrieval, no escalation path.

source_status.description: The licence position of the cited source. See docs/SOURCES.md.

tau.description: The per-provision charging threshold. Constitutional: changed only by a legislative enactment, never by the function that applies it.

violate.description: violates(c,p) is true exactly when facts(c) intersects this set.
